segments.name: sporting goods
segments.description: Runs sporting goods and outdoor recreation stores in the United States.
segments.evidence: We operate in one operating segment with one reporting unit.

revenueModel.text: Shoppers buy sporting goods, apparel and footwear in its stores and online.
revenueModel.evidence: Our product assortment focuses on key categories of outdoor, sports & recreation, apparel, and footwear (representing 31%, 22%, 27% and 20% of our 2025 net sales, respectively) through both leading national brands and a portfolio of 19 private label brands, which go well beyond traditional sporting goods and apparel offerings.
